steps.code:
# Read all markdown files and prepare titles
files_data = []
for path in dir_listing:
    file_info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=path, access_token=fs_token)
    basename = path.split('/')[-1]
    title = basename[:-3].replace('_', ' ')  # remove .md and replace underscores
    files_data.append({'path': path, 'title': title, 'content': file_info['content']})
print(f"Total files: {len(files_data)}")
print("First 3 titles:", [f['title'] for f in files_data[:3]])

boundaries.summary:
GOAL
Import markdown notes in the "~/documents/personal/simple_note/" directory of my file system to my Simple Note account. Each markdown file should become a separate note in the Simple Note account. The title of each note should be taken from the name of the source file (excluding the directory path and file extension), replacing underscores in it with blank spaces.

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()

API DOCS ALREADY READ (exact signatures; do not call api_docs again for these)
- file_system apis: show_account, signup, delete_account, update_account_name, login, logout, send_verification_code, verify_account, send_password_reset_code, reset_password, show_profile, search_notes, create_note, show_note, delete_note, update_note, add_content_to_note
- supervisor apis: show_active_task, complete_task, show_profile, show_addresses, show_payment_cards, show_account_passwords

- simple_note.create_note(title:string[length >= 1], content:string, access_token:string, tags:list[string]?, pinned:boolean?) -> {message, note_id}  # Create a new note

- simple_note.show_account(access_token:string) -> {first_name, last_name, email, registered_at, last_logged_in, verified}  # Show your account information. Unlike show_profile, this includes private information
- file_system.login(username:string, password:string) -> {access_token, token_type}  # Login to your account
- simple_note.login(username:string, password:string) -> {access_token, token_type}  # Login to your account
